summary: Frontend-only regression of the fully-rebuilt Vue generale tab (OverviewTab.jsx). All 3 rows render with correct data-testids. Data coherence verified across panels (categories + inactive sum to total, active% + inactive% = 100%). Period change 7j -> 30j works and refreshes all metrics + eco panel. Cross-tab navigation from kpi-cat-*, link-vehicles and link-drivers works. Regression on Analyse flotte, Conducteurs, Vehicules, Couts, IoT tabs: all load without console errors or blank screens. No forbidden fabricated metrics ($, TCO, satisfaction, risque d'usure) detected.

issues: Header shows '0 actifs' while KPI card shows 'Flotte active 5/12'. Both are technically correct (currently-moving vs. active-over-period) but the wording collision may confuse users — consider clarifying the header label.

action_items: Non-blocking: recharts warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' briefly logged when switching to Analyse flotte — caused by a ResponsiveContainer being mounted with 0-size parent during tab transition. Consider gating charts behind an isVisible check or setting minWidth/minHeight.
Cosmetic: consider clarifying header 'X actifs' vs card 'Flotte active X/Y' to avoid ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: OverviewTab.jsx line 86-88: fuel aggregation logic uses reduce with a ternary but the initial accumulator is 0 — if all vehicles have fuel_used_liters === null, fuelL stays 0 but fuelAvailable also stays false, which is correctly handled. OK.

Anomaly 'offline' currently fires for every vehicle whose connection_status !== 'active'. In current live data 12/12 are 'hors ligne'. Verify that Navixy connection_status semantics match business intent (may be 'idle' vs 'moving' vs 'offline').
context_for_next_testing_agent: OverviewTab v2 fully covered: KPI band, panels, anomalies, eco (cached=fast, cold=~27s), period switch, cross-tab navigation, regression on all other tabs. Live fleet: 12 vehicles, 5 used, 7 inactive on 7d; on 30d fuel = 1310.3 L / 2621 CHF; eco drivers Orhan (3 stars/56) & Ivan (1 star/9).
